fieldData.general-information: Step out of Bow Valley College confident—and equipped with credits that transfer.

fieldData.info-2: The Bharwani School of Arts and Sciences fosters a dynamic learning environment that encourages critical thinking, creativity, and intellectual growth, preparing students for success in their chosen fields.
fieldData.about-us: Choose from arts and sciences courses that fit your goals. Gain confidence in your academic skills in our supportive environment, and earn credits you can apply towards a certificate, diploma, or degree here or anywhere else!

fieldData.school-short-description: Be a leader in building stronger communities.
fieldData.school-description: You can have a positive impact in your community while you build a rewarding career. Start with a certificate or diploma, or expand your current career options with a post-diploma certificate and continuing education courses.
fieldData.tagline: Graduate ready to make a difference in your communities.
fieldData.general-information: Gain the skills to make a meaningful impact in social work, community development, the nonprofit sector, social enterprises, and social economy organizations, all while helping create stronger, more efficient communities.
fieldData.info-1: A wide range of programs, including Justice Studies, Addiction Studies, Disability Studies, Early Childhood Education and Development, Education Assistant, Social Work, and Child and Youth Care.
fieldData.info-2: With a solid foundation in community studies, you’ll be ready to pursue careers in social work, law enforcement, or continue your education to unlock even more opportunities.
fieldData.info-3: Students engage in community projects and initiatives that support underserved populations. These opportunities allow students to make a meaningful difference while developing the skills needed to work in diverse and underrepresented communities.
fieldData.about-us:
Turn your passion for helping others into a career. Our Community Studies programs prepare you to create real social impact in fields like social work, justice studies, and disability studies.  You'll gain valuable experience through community-based projects and internships, guided by expert faculty. Drive innovation and support to create thriving, sustainable communities.

The School of Community Studies helps shape future community leaders. Community is at the heart of everything we do. We train students to build connections, support others, and create lasting change through progress. With expert guidance and a focus on integrity, graduates are ready to make a difference.
fieldData.name: School of Community Studies

fieldData.school-short-description: Get the hands-on practice you need for a career in healthcare.
fieldData.school-description: You want to make a real difference in the lives of others. We want to help you achieve your goals. Choosing a career in healthcare means choosing a future of caring. Your career in health and wellness puts you on the front lines of making a real, tangible difference in the lives of others.
fieldData.general-information:
Through the School of Health and Wellness, it’s possible.

In just two years, you could become a Licensed Practical Nurse, Pharmacy Technician, Health Care Aide, and more.
fieldData.tagline-bold: Together, we can make it happen.
fieldData.info-1:
Our Simulation Labs replicate a real-world clinic with hospital beds, functioning medical equipment, and AI-driven mannequins that interact with students. This hands-on experience builds confidence and prepares students for real-world healthcare challenges.

Learn more >>
fieldData.info-2:
Health Care Aides (HCAs) provide up to 80% of direct care for older Canadians, serving as the primary frontline caregivers in long-term care and at home.

Learn more >>
fieldData.info-3:
This VR system immerses students in lifelike patient scenarios, helping them practice symptom identification and decision-making. This interactive training builds confidence and prepares them for real-world healthcare settings.

Learn more >>
fieldData.about-us:
At our school, you’ll gain a comprehensive healthcare education with a wide range of in-demand programs including nursing, pharmacy, and therapy. You'll learn through hands-on, industry-relevant training led by experienced faculty, preparing you to start your career with confidence.

Health and Wellness isn't just a term. It's a career path that empowers you to make a difference through caring.

Our programs offer you the opportunity to specialize in areas like perioperative and interdisciplinary therapy, giving you the skills to meet growing healthcare demands. We’ll equip you to serve diverse communities with compassion and integrity, starting from day one. With a supportive environment and forward-focused curriculum, we’ll help you build the confidence and expertise to make a real difference in the lives of others—empowering you to succeed in your healthcare career.
fieldData.name: School of Health and Wellness

fieldData.school-short-description: Your pathway to a career or further education.
fieldData.school-description: The School of Foundational Learning has flexible pathways to open the door to your future. If you were waiting for a sign to kick-start your education journey, this is it. We offer adult basic education, high school upgrading, Indigenous foundational learning, and pathways to careers. Place yourself on a path to post-secondary education and beyond in a flexible and nurturing learning environment.
fieldData.tagline: Build a strong foundation for the next step in your education.
fieldData.general-information: Starting your education might feel overwhelming but our supportive learning environment will give you the confidence to move forward.
fieldData.tagline-bold: The right place to jump-start your education.
fieldData.info-1:
Bow Valley College is recognized nationally as a leader in the field of literacy development.

The College is a partner institution in the national Skills for Success project, which is revamping Employment and Social Development Canada’s literacy and essential skills framework.

‍
fieldData.info-2: With small class sizes, instructors provide personalized attention to each student. Additional support services, including academic aids, writing specialists, and retention officers, are available to help students overcome challenges and succeed in their studies.
fieldData.about-us:
Foundational learning equips you with essential skills and knowledge you’ll require to succeed at Bow Valley College.

Our program equips students with essential skills for employment and further education. It emphasizes community engagement, work experience, and academic growth, all while supporting students' mental, physical, spiritual, and emotional well-being.

The School of Foundational Learning takes you beyond upgrading—we focus on helping you build the essential skills and knowledge to get you qualified for college programs. We lay the groundwork for your academic success and prepare you to handle the challenges of higher education.
fieldData.name: School of Foundational Learning

fieldData.school-short-description: Get the hands-on skills needed to bring your creativity to life and the right credentials to launch your career.

Prepare for a successful career with our diploma and post-diploma certificate programs.
fieldData.tagline: Design the future with advanced technology skills.
fieldData.general-information:
A creative revolution is sweeping through Alberta's industries.

Join the epic battle against mediocrity and be on the leading edge of this dynamic wave. Discover rewarding careers in technology industries with diplomas and post-diploma certificates through the School of Technology.
fieldData.tagline-bold: Learn the skills you’ll need to change the world.
fieldData.info-1: Our instructors are industry professionals who bring insider knowledge, hands-on expertise, and personal insight into what it takes to succeed.
fieldData.info-2: From LED Volume virtual production tech, to medical lab simulators to cybersecurity systems, the School of Technology stays ahead of the curve.
fieldData.info-3: The Digital Entertainment Nexus at Bow Valley College is a state-of-the-art hub bridging technology and creativity. With cutting-edge facilities, it offers students hands-on experience in digital design, interactive media, and entertainment technology.
fieldData.about-us: Our technology-driven approach to learning empowers students to think creatively and push boundaries. This spirit of innovation shapes everything we do—it challenges perspectives, fosters agility, and sparks new ideas. From the classroom to the workforce, our graduates make an impact in meaningful ways.

fieldData.school-short-description: Flexible learning and practical experience at the Chiu School of Business get you career-ready in just one or two years.
fieldData.school-description: Our programs are built for the real-world. With hands-on learning and strong industry connections, you’ll gain the experience you need to thrive globally. You’ll apply classroom knowledge in practical settings, building skills that employers value. Networking opportunities and industry partnerships ensure you’re ready to make an impact from day one.
fieldData.tagline: Want to be work ready in one or two years? At Chiu School of Business, we’ll help get you there.
fieldData.general-information:
Others talk business solutions.

At Chiu School of Business, you’ll develop bold ideas, innovative thinking, and hands-on experience.
fieldData.info-1: Learn from experience. Mentors are experienced professionals who provide students with guidance, career advice, and industry insights, helping students build networks, gain practical knowledge, and receive support in career development.
fieldData.info-2: Develop skills in action. These popular competitions challenge students to tackle business case issues. Build essential skills like problem solving, critical thinking, and teamwork. Gain hands-on experience while showcasing your talents and building your resume.
fieldData.info-3: Launch your business. This program gives students the skills to bring ideas to life, whether launching a small business or the next big innovation. Learn how to create business plans, overcome challenges, and turn your vision into the next viral venture.
fieldData.about-us:
The Chiu School of Business is a distinguished faculty at Bow Valley College, offering a comprehensive range of programs designed to prepare students for successful careers in finance, human resources, management, digital marketing, and more. With a focus on experiential learning, the school provides practical training to equip students with the skills needed to excel in today’s workforce. Flexible learning options include diplomas, certificates, and degree pathways. Instructors at the Chiu School of Business offer decades of global industry experience, bringing their expertise and insights from business success directly into the classroom.

Who are Wayne and Eleanor Chiu?

A transformative $3 million gift from Wayne and Eleanor Chiu, the founders of Trico Homes, has allowed the Chiu School of Business to expand its educational initiatives and better address the changing demands of both students and the business world. This substantial donation continues to fuel innovative programs and provide valuable hands-on learning experiences for students.
fieldData.name: Chiu School of Business
